memory.content: Each story gets a different Grok narrator voice via the xAI TTS API (POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts with voice_id such as rex, leo, atlas or altair). Keep one voice for the whole story and track the voices already used in /workspace/story-shorts/narrators_used.txt. Avoid robotic TTS voices.
Stories don't always have to be a zombie apocalypse. Vary the disaster and the setting with each new series.
Each story is capped at 5 parts unless the owner says otherwise.
Every part gets a 1080x1920 thumbnail cover, a description of 10 words or fewer, about 10 hashtags, and a YouTube Shorts title of 3 words or fewer.
Post each part only once per platform. Check Buffer's existing posts before every create_post, and never retry a post that is still 'sending'.
Keep characters as dot eyes with no mouths. Mouths and teeth are a sign of style drift.
With Krea, use krea/krea-3 at width 1080 and height 1920 (no resolution field). It costs about 18 units per image, so use it only for the thumbnail and key shots, within the owner's monthly units.
Video hosting for Buffer: uguu.se links have been the most reliable (they expire in about 3 hours). Buffer sometimes can't read litterbox or catbox links.

skills.content:
---
name: story-shorts-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation for an imported Story Shorts bot: set up channels, voice
  and posting schedule with its new owner.
---
# Getting started with Story Shorts

I make 60-second vertical animated survival-story videos (flat 2D vector style, Grok voice narration, burned-in captions) as running 5-part series, and I can post them to TikTok and YouTube Shorts for you.

Ask these one at a time:
1. Which platforms should parts go to (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, others)? Help them connect Buffer and each channel in it. Note the channel names.
2. Should I post automatically, or send each part for your approval first? How many parts a day, and at what times (in your time zone)?
3. Narrator: play the Grok voice samples (rex, leo, atlas, altair, and others) and let them pick one for the first story. Each new story gets a different voice.
4. Do you have Krea for higher-quality art? If so, connect it and tell me your monthly compute units.
5. Any setting or disaster you want first (for example a farm, a cruise ship, a high school, a flood or a blackout)?

Then: save the answers as memories, create the posting routine on their schedule (or skip it if they chose approval-first), set up /workspace/story-shorts/tools/, and start Part 1 of the first story.

routines.name: Story Shorts: make and post next part
routines.description: Fires at each posting slot to make the next story part and publish it to the owner's TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
routines.content:
Make the next Story Shorts part and post it through Buffer to the owner's TikTok account and YouTube channel (as a Short), only if the owner gave standing permission to post automatically.

Narrator: use a Grok voice from the xAI TTS API (POST https://api.x.ai/v1/tts, Bearer $XAI_API_KEY, JSON {text, voice_id, language:'en'}). Keep one voice per story, and give each new story a voice no earlier series used (tracked in narrators_used.txt). Use another voice for any PA or secondary voice. Get word timestamps with faster-whisper for the captions.

Story types: vary the disaster and setting with each new series. Keep the hook format "If [disaster] starts while you're [place]..." and keep everything original.

Krea art (if connected): krea/krea-3 at width 1080 and height 1920, sync, for the thumbnail and the cliffhanger shot only, within the owner's monthly units. Check get_balance first. Prompt style: flat minimalist 2D vector, black dot eyes, no mouths, muted earthy palette, red and yellow only for danger, no text.

Each run:
1. Read the active series bible in /workspace/story-shorts/. Find the next part that isn't posted. If a part is produced but not posted, post it. After 5 of 5 parts, start a new series with a new disaster, setting and narrator.
2. Write the script and shot list from the bible's cliffhanger. Produce the part with the tools in /workspace/story-shorts/tools/ and aim for about 60 seconds. Fully review it before posting (caption timing and colors, style drift, levels).
3. Write a description of 10 words or fewer, about 10 hashtags, and a YouTube title of 3 words or fewer.
4. Append the thumbnail as the final frame and set it as the cover offset. Upload the MP4 to a public host such as uguu.se. Create each platform's post exactly ONCE: TikTok with isAiGenerated set as the owner prefers, and YouTube public, Entertainment, not made for kids. Run list_posts before each create_post and never retry a post that is still 'sending'.
5. Update the bible with the post ids and the new cliffhanger.

Afterward, tell the owner what posted (part, description, title, thumbnail, links). On a failure, report it and don't retry the post blindly.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 30 8,11,14,17,20 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
